svg.metadata: {"story":"Esther","act":8,"chapter":"Ch.8 · The Second Banquet","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Esther names her people and her enemy; Haman pleads on the couch and is hanged on the gallows he built for Mordecai.
